core_obligations: Show projectivity implies being a direct summand of a free module: choose a surjection from a free module and split it by the lifting property (proof lines 19023-19027).

Show the direct summand condition implies the vanishing of Ext one for every module, and conversely that the vanishing of Ext one splits the presentation of the module and hence exhibits it as a projective, which closes the cycle (proof lines 19030-19059).
proof_roadmap: Get the direct summand property from lifting (proof lines 19022-19027).
Compute Ext one on a presentation and close the equivalence (proof lines 19030-19060).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that projectivity, being a direct summand of a free module, and the vanishing of Ext one against every module are equivalent (statement lines 19011-19020). The proof does not quote the standard characterisations: it splits a surjection from a free module by the lifting property, uses that splitting to kill Ext one by a direct summand argument, and conversely exhibits the splitting of a presentation from the vanishing of Ext one (proof lines 19022-19060). Reading the vanishing of Ext one as the splitting of a presentation is the step that closes the cycle. H2.
